ModMetaData.name: Rules of Engagement Patches
ModMetaData.author: StaticNS
ModMetaData.description:
I don't like the current loadout policy editor for Rules of Engagement. So I made some changes. Also, I wanted a way to manually start a restock job. Did that too.
Credit goes to the original mod auther @Asunib for the amazing mod. I take no credit for the orginal functionality. I only added on top of what is already there.
Yes, this mod is AI assisted. No, I will not trudge through undocumented API and decompiled code for multiple days. I want to play the game.
